InvGate - Build a state-of-the-art IT operation

content.text:
**“IntelGate” can refer to a few different things, depending on context:**

1. **A Japanese IT company — intelgate, Inc.**  
   A Tokyo-based company that provides internet/content production, web marketing, consulting, and related online business services. Its name combines “Intel” from “internet” and “gate” as an “entry point.” ([intelgate.co.jp](https://intelgate.co.jp/?utm_source=openai))

2. **A political-scandal label — “Intelgate”**  
   Sometimes used to describe alleged manipulation of U.S. CENTCOM intelligence analysis about Syria/Iraq and ISIS, especially around 2015. It has also been used more loosely in political commentary about intelligence-community controversies. ([military-history.fandom.com](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Intelgate?utm_source=openai))

3. **A software/digital-solutions company named INTELGATE**  
   A small software and digital solutions company listed on LinkedIn, based in Gazimağusa/Famagusta, founded in 2017. ([cy.linkedin.com](https://cy.linkedin.com/company/intelgate?utm_source=openai))

4. **Possibly a typo for “InvGate”**  
   If you meant **InvGate**, that’s an IT service management / IT asset management platform used for help desk, asset inventory, ITAM, workflows, etc. ([invgate.com](https://invgate.com/?utm_source=openai))

If you saw “IntelGate” in a specific article, app, device, or political discussion, send me the context and I can identify which one it is.
